proposed.explanation:
ETEL's FY2025 results show strong fundamental momentum: operating revenue grew ~30.6% to 106.67 billion EGP, net profit more than doubled to 22.58 billion EGP, and EPS rose from 4.79 to 11.93 EGP/share. At the current price of 141.95 EGP, the trailing P/E is roughly 11.9×, which is reasonable for a company growing at this rate. Total equity expanded ~38.6% to 63.69 billion EGP, indicating the company is retaining and compounding earnings rather than distributing them all.

For your 5–7-year university-fee goal, a growth-oriented equity position with a medium risk profile fits. Holding your 300 shares (worth 42,585 EGP) is supported by the evidence: the company is scaling revenue and profit quickly, and the valuation is not stretched.

Important caveats and risks:
• Concentration: ETEL already represents about 68% of your 62,585 EGP portfolio. This is above the 50% diversification guideline. I am not recommending a buy (which would worsen concentration) nor a forced sell, but you should be aware that a single-stock position carries idiosyncratic risk. If you can identify other suitable listed companies in the future, consider trimming ETEL to bring it below half the portfolio.
• The 20,000 EGP cash is best kept as a buffer for now. We have no evidence on other listed companies to recommend a diversifying purchase, and buying more ETEL would breach the 50% concentration limit.
• The evidence covers only FY2024 and FY2025 consolidated statements. There is no dividend data, no forward guidance, no sector comparison, and no information on debt levels or cash-flow quality. A single year of strong growth does not guarantee continuation.
• Egyptian equities carry currency, regulatory, and market-liquidity risks that are not captured in these financial statements.

In summary: the fundamentals support continuing to hold ETEL, but the position is concentrated and the evidence base is limited to two years of consolidated accounts. Reassess when additional company data or alternative investment opportunities become available.
